verdict.rationale: Ramp's own marketing claims hotel rate monitoring with automatic rebooking when prices drop by $50 or more, which is the story's core capability. However, it is limited to hotels and backed only by a single one-line claim. The CLI's travel resource shows travel is agent-accessible, but nothing ties rate monitoring or rebooking to agents. Missing for 10: monitoring of flights and other non-hotel bookings, in-depth docs on how monitoring and rebooking work, agent/API/MCP exposure or control of the rebooking feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
